Approach

From priorities to follow-through.

My work is tailored to each client. There is no ready-made formula, because every brand is at a different moment, with its own needs, challenges and goals.

First, I understand where the client is, where they want to go and what needs to be the priority. From there, we build a clear direction and move forward strategically, one step at a time.

I also follow the execution, helping turn strategy into action and making sure growth comes with the structure needed to sustain it.

01

Understand

I learn the business, the audience and what needs to be the priority.

02

Plan

I define a clear direction: positioning, actions and who does what.

03

Coordinate and execute

I move one step at a time and keep content, partners and events moving together.

04

Review

Together, we review what worked and adjust the next steps.

The Woman Blue

Helping women take back their paths, their dreams and their independence.

A social-impact initiative created for women rebuilding their lives after motherhood, years dedicated to family, or difficult relationships — helping them reconnect with education, work, independence and their own ambitions.

The idea

She didn’t lose her potential. She stopped seeing it.

The Woman Blue turns that idea into a community, campaigns and experiences designed to help women recognize themselves again and take their next step.
